mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which directly boosts corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% indicates rising inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing real equity returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 650,000 units signals weakening housing market activity, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust demand-supply coordination, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment recovery, a decline in UNRATE below 10% combined with PAYEMS growth above 100,000 jobs signals accelerating labor market improvement, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of high-unemployment recovery periods when UNRATE declines below 10% and PAYEMS rises above 100,000.
